prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
`mkdir` is the portable test-and-set command for recovering safely under parallel `make`.

```make
if mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null; then \
  rm -f data.stamp; \
  $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) data.stamp; \
  result=$$?; rm -rf data.lock; exit $$result; \
else \
  while test -d data.lock; do sleep 1; done; \
fi
```

The first process that successfully creates `data.lock` performs the rebuild; other processes wait until the lock directory is removed.
